english.title: Disclose information acquired under section 204 or Chapter III of Part IV of Water Industry Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information furnished to you under

(A)_[section 204]_
(B)_[Chapter III of Part IV]_of the Water Industry Act 1991 other than as permitted under section 206(2) of the Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 206(2), (7) and (9) of the Water Industry Act 1991.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
